Its moves are a new CEO of Peak Ace AG, Michael Neuner, named in 2026-02, a Silver at the 2025 Global Search Awards, and a GA4 LLM Traffic Dashboard. The record points it at AI answer visibility layered on a search business. A rival should know it sells AI visibility with no llms.txt, its sitemap shows 0 URLs updated in 90 days, 10 of 11 clients on record are names only, and the Horus read marks KJ6 exposure at -0.798.
doing:
The positioning line, an award winning international digital marketing agency from Berlin, search led across SEA, SEO and content marketing and now pushing LLMO/GEO consulting and AI solutions, decodes as a search shop adding an AI answer layer to what it already sells. The headline claim is awards: 130+ of them, including Best Large Integrated Agency and Best Use of Search, with campaigns in 25+ languages, and homepage stats of 130+ staff, 200+ clients and 3 locations, all quoted as claims.

Three lines lead at score 3. Content & Digital PR: the meta names content marketing, AutoScout24 and Zava content cases are featured, and a Crisis Response Content Campaign of the Year award is cited. Paid Search: the meta leads with SEA, the featured SharkNinja PPC case targets revenue, conversion rate and ROAS, and a Best European PPC Campaign award is cited. SEO: award winning SEO cases for faireparterie and kartenmacherei and the Global Search Awards best large integrated SEO agency title. Three core lines score 2. AI Automation: a KI Lösungen offer in the nav, LinkedIn ads pushing AI automation webinars for PPC, and the custom GPT suite of 2024. AI Search / GEO: an LLM Consulting and GEO page, an LLMO & GEO agency nav entry, an LLM optimisation guide and the GA4 LLM Traffic Dashboard. Data & Measurement: a Digital Analytics service and a highlight case on tracking for higher card acceptance in Germany. Seven lines score 1; local and web build score 0. Proprietary: the LLM Traffic Dashboard, the Peak Ace GPT suite and a Google SGE Assessment. The record lists no partners.

AI posture in plain terms: it sells LLM consulting and GEO to make brands trusted AI answer sources, plus AI solutions, and markets PPC automation and the GA4 dashboard; no audited AI visibility product shows (P1 partial).

Moves in date order: 2024-01 the custom GPT suite; 2024-02 success at the 2024 European Content Awards; 2025 Silver at the Global Search Awards; 2026-02 HEROIKS named Michael Neuner CEO of Peak Ace AG. Undated: the GA4 LLM Traffic Dashboard release, four nav lines flagged new (LLMO & GEO agency, AI solutions, LLM consulting, Social Search), and a press headline on CWS Hygiene choosing it as digital growth partner in Europe.

Pricing: a separate KMU Lösungen (SME solutions) line in the nav hints at packaged offers for smaller firms, with no prices shown. Conspicuously absent: any sitemap update in 90 days, any partner, and a readable Google ads record, since the Transparency Center lookup was blocked.
clients:

The needs read holds 11 clients, 1 observed and 10 names only; most case titles are figurative, so the code finds no work in them. The one observed need is AutoScout24, coded brand and creative from Against all odds, crisis proven content; its slug adds growth across Europe.

Titles and notes say more than the code: SharkNinja's A clean path to growth is the featured PPC case the Paid Search note ties to revenue, conversion rate and ROAS. Softgarden is Recruiting clients for a recruiting specialist, Pool-Chlor-Shop is Swimming against the COVID-19 tide, and Zava, a featured content case, is Trust me, I'm an online doctor. Nets and Concardis share Reinvention of a Nordic Giant; a Concardis tracking case for higher card acceptance in Germany is the Data & Measurement highlight. The SEO note names faireparterie (A match made in heaven) and kartenmacherei as award winning SEO work. Smartbroker is a SMARTBROKER+ page; CWS Hygiene is a press headline choosing Peak Ace as digital growth partner in Europe. For these 10 the need is inferred from its lead lines: SEA, SEO and content.

Two are shared: SharkNinja with brave-bison and ayima, Zava with columbia-road.

With KJ1 (the click replaced by the citation, net 0.278) and KJ2 (ads inside AI answers, net 0.199) its tailwinds, it is likely, with moderate confidence, that these brands next ask for AI answer visibility with a number behind it, which the LLM dashboard markets but no audit backs (P1 partial). The SEA and SEO hours they buy are very likely the ones KJ6 hollows out.
